attempts.summary: Configured a persistent routed WireGuard wg01 tunnel between node1 and node2 for 192.168.10.0/24 (lan-a) and 192.168.20.0/24 (lan-b). Node3 serves TCP/8080, and node4 receives HTTP 200 through the tunnel. Source addresses remain unchanged, no NAT is configured, and default-deny forwarding permits only new node4-to-node3 TCP/8080 connections. All four nodes were restarted individually and fully recovered.
